items.note: Yemeni government forces said Monday they had retaken the Red Sea port of Mokha and secured the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
The Nigerian Air Force said an ATR-42 with tail NGR 931 crashed on 5 October near the naval base in Igbokoda; 32 were aboard.
Saxony-Anhalt's newly elected Landtag was due to sit with AfD's Tobias Rausch nominated for president; the vote is not in.
The Pentagon said Monday evening that President Trump approved Hegseth's recommendation to execute Nidal Hasan by Army firing squad.
Parti Québécois was leading or elected in 59 of 127 National Assembly seats on Monday night, against 64 needed for a majority.
Darya Shipilova, 28, became ill at the anti-plague institute in Irkutsk and died on the night of 2 October in Shelekhov.

lead.what: Tail NGR 931 lost radio at 09:13 WAT on a Benin-to-Lagos hop and crashed near the naval base in Igbokoda. 32 were aboard; casualties remain unconfirmed.

rest.what: Yemeni government forces said Monday they had retaken the Red Sea port of Mokha and secured the Bab al-Mandab Strait. Houthi-run media denied advances in Dhubab.

lead.what: There is a 28% probability that the Parti Québécois holds a majority when Élections Québec posts a complete official count by 16:00 UTC on 12 October. The party was leading or elected in 59 of 127 seats on Monday night, against 64 needed.

rest.what: Saxony-Anhalt's Landtag was due to sit in Magdeburg with AfD's Tobias Rausch nominated for president on BSW's five votes; the vote is not in.

lead.what: The Pentagon said Monday evening that President Trump approved Hegseth's recommendation to execute Nidal Hasan by Army firing squad. The Army secretary will decide a time and place.

rest.what: Darya Shipilova, 28, died on the night of 2 October in Shelekhov after falling ill at the Irkutsk anti-plague institute. Officials have not named a pathogen.
